user.title: HA Gaming Hub — Select Modules
user.description: Choose which modules to enable. You can enable multiple modules.

free_games.title: Free Games — Configuration
free_games.description:
Configure the Free Games module. Sources: Epic Games Store and GamerPower. No API key required.

Optional: enter your Steam API Key and SteamID64 to mark free games that are also in your Steam wishlist with a ⭐ badge.

data.steam_api_key: Steam API Key (optional, for wishlist badge)

price_tracker.title: Price Tracker — Configuration
price_tracker.description:
Configure the Price Tracker module. The ITAD API key is optional; leave blank to use CheapShark only.

Optional: enter your SteamID64 to enable wishlist matching. Steam API Key is only needed here if you also want to pre-fill it for the Presence module.

data.steam_api_key: Steam API Key (optional, for Presence pre-fill)

steam.title: Presence — Steam Configuration
steam.description: Enter your Steam API key and the Steam IDs or vanity URLs to track. Leave both fields blank to skip Steam presence and go to Xbox. Vanity URLs will be resolved automatically.

data.steam_ids: Steam IDs / Vanity URLs (leave blank to skip)

xbox_entity.title: Presence — Xbox Accounts
xbox_entity.description: The following Xbox accounts were detected from the native Xbox integration. Select which ones to track alongside Steam.

psn_entity.title: Presence — PlayStation Network Accounts
psn_entity.description:
Select a sensor for each PlayStation Network account you want to track (any sensor of the account works — its online-status and now-playing sensors are resolved automatically).

If nothing appears here, make sure the PlayStation Network integration is installed and configured first.

summary.title: Configuration Summary

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure HA Gaming Hub
reconfigure.description: The wizard will restart from the module selection step. All current values are pre-filled.
